meta.name: airflow-dag-patterns
meta.description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.

copy.tagline: 构建生产级的数据管道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是数据工程师,用 Airflow 编排任务,想写出更规范的 DAG。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage data pipelines and want reliable, maintainable DAGs.

howto.what: 该技能提供生产级 Airflow DAG 模板与最佳实践，涵盖任务依赖写法、快速上手示例、测试与部署建议，并提醒避免常见陷阱（如 depends_on_past、硬编码日期等）。
howto.when: 当你要创建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批处理作业时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Airflow DAG，每天早上6点跑 ETL。
say.note: 它会按最佳实践给出代码框架。

say.text: 这个 DAG 里怎么设置任务依赖，做个 fan-out？
say.note: 它会展示依赖写法并说明含义。

say.text: 用 TaskFlow API 重写我的 extract 任务。
say.note: 它会给出简化后的代码。

howto.what_en: Provides production-ready Airflow DAG patterns covering task dependencies, quick-start examples, testing and deployment tips, along with best practices and common pitfalls to avoid.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, or schedule batch jobs.

say_en.text: Write an Airflow DAG that runs ETL at 6 AM daily.
say_en.note: It will produce a code skeleton with best practices.

say_en.text: How to set task dependencies with a fan-out pattern?
say_en.note: It will show the syntax and explanation.

say_en.text: Rewrite my extract task using the TaskFlow API.
say_en.note: It will give a simplified version.
